review_notes: Visually inspected questionnaires_and_target.png, sleep_extension_distributions.png and extension_correlations.png before estimator fitting.
Training target is imbalanced: 1111 low, 3290 moderate, 639 high. Retain predeclared balanced models, macro-F1 and per-class recall reporting.
All ordinal proxy categories are populated, with fewer extreme categories; these are simulated proxies, not validated self-report instruments.
Sleep plots show a zero-nap mass and two time-awake modes induced by the fixed nap scheduling policy. This is a simulation artifact, not a discovered human pattern.
WASO has an expected zero mass for zero awakenings; positive values are allocated from pre-existing sleep aggregates.

Correlation plot shows near-redundancy of main sleep and total-24h sleep, and strong nap/time-awake coupling. Retain preregistered bundles to evaluate incremental value without adaptive feature removal.
Proxy/current-fatigue association is designed through shared latent fatigue. Any measured improvement is limited to those simulation assumptions.
Shortened one clipped plot title and corrected spacing only; regenerated the same training-only graphs before this review record.
27 generation check groups and 15 training EDA checks passed; no rows removed, no noise levels retuned; held-out statistics have not been inspected.
